body:
Source-derived follow-up to #825 at7a87b33115c0cd45b14cac64d7b37e5742503159; no measured token or compiler memory gain is established.

Actual WorkspaceGraph CLI currently calls snapshot then slice report (src/cli_driver.rs:1021–1022). source_execution.rs:703–715 uses Diagnostic::json() or eprintln; diagnostic.rs:103–129 builds owned JSON Strings. Remove avoidable intermediate String ownership by adding a shared writer renderer and adopting it in the actual CLI report path, including its existing typed reporting failure consumer when admitted. Keep the old Diagnostic::json compatibility API byte-equivalent and avoid an unused alternate renderer.

Preserve exact JSON field order, escaping, nulls, paths/spans/help, human text, output stream/newline behavior and original selected compiler status. Writer failure cannot replace sticky compiler failure or publish partial authoritative artifacts. Use the existing error/report contracts, complete independent old renderer controls, hostile Unicode/control/quote/path/help cases and ordered multiple errors. Measure actual String allocation changes and complete Drop for old/current owning renderers, including unfavorable cases; do not infer agent token savings.

Streaming is NOT proof of funding. Existing WorkspaceReportFailure explicitly assigns output storage to renderer caller; no already-prepaid CLI output owner was found. Do not claim zero-budget bounded output or #825 closure without genuine authenticated caller storage/control authority. Retain explicit compatibility routes and disclose output funding residuals. No changed limits, fee exemptions, build-time network, test weakening or new ambient authority. Run only focused renderer/CLI controls and scoped Clippy in one consolidated implementation batch; regenerate any moved pins using actual producers and consumers.
title: (OPT) Render actual CLI diagnostics through a shared writer without intermediate JSON Strings
